step1_analysis.description: A clocked dynamic comparator featuring a PMOS input differential pair and an NMOS cross-coupled latch. It operates in two phases: a reset phase where the internal nodes are pulled to ground, and an evaluation phase where the input pair injects current into the cross-coupled latch to resolve the differential input into a full-swing digital output. It is typically used as a quantizer in delta-sigma modulators.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 10-MHz Clock-Rate 13-Bit CMOS Modulator Using Unity-Gain-Reset Opamps

propagation_delay.description: Time from the falling edge of the clock (start of evaluation phase) to the output resolving to a valid logic level.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is dominated by the time to charge the internal nodes to the NMOS threshold and the subsequent regeneration time. t_pd ≈ (C_load * Vth / I_tail) + t_regen + t_inv.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 at 1.8V is significantly faster than the 0.35µm process at 1V used in the paper. The 12ns delay reported in the paper will scale down to a few nanoseconds.

average_power.description: Average power consumption of the comparator operating at the target clock frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: P_avg = VDD * I_avg. With a 20µA bias, the tail current is ~20µA. Current flows primarily during the evaluation phase. Dynamic power P_dyn = C * VDD^2 * f is small at 10MHz (~1µW).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 5.6mW for the entire modulator. A single comparator at 10MHz in Sky130 will consume a small fraction of this, dictated mostly by the bias current and evaluation duty cycle.

decision_threshold.description: Minimum input differential voltage required to reliably flip the latch (input offset).

sky130_expected.calculation: V_os = delta_Vth + (Vgs - Vth) * (delta_W/W). In an ideal schematic simulation without mismatch, V_os is 0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ideal SPICE models have perfect matching, resulting in zero offset. In reality, mismatch would cause 1-10mV offset, requiring Monte Carlo analysis to observe.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure the propagation delay and average power consumption of the dynamic comparator at a 10.24 MHz clock rate with a 10mV differential input.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 LABEL_NET_2 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 LABEL_NET_3 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Ibias N3 0 20u

* Clock: 10.24 MHz -> 97.656 ns period. Active low for evaluation.
VCLK_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(1.8 0 5n 1n 1n 50n 97.656n)
VCLK_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 5n 1n 1n 50n 97.656n)

* Inputs: Common mode 0.9V, diff 10mV (INP > INN)
VINP LABEL_NET_2 0 0.905
VINN LABEL_NET_3 0 0.895

* Load Capacitance
C1 N1 0 10f
C2 N4 0 10f

.control
  tran 0.1n 200n
  
  * Delay from CLK falling to N4 falling (Since INP > INN, N2 goes high, N4 goes low)
  meas tran t_delay trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N4) val=0.9 fall=1
  
  * Power consumption over one clock cycle
  meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=97.656n
  let power_mw = -pwr_avg * 1.8 * 1000
  print power_mw
  
  * Check final states to ensure correct resolution
  meas tran v_N4_final find v(N4) at=50n
  meas tran v_N1_final find v(N1) at=50n
  
  quit
.endc
